text:
anya: Heads-up — console alarm: EU-1 hourly aggregate rehydrates spiked to ~18k queued overnight. Not sure if it's duplicate submits or ingest late arrivals.
devon: I saw the surge at 02:12 UTC, replayer CPU hit 95% and a few OOMs. Autoscaler kicked but lagged.
matt: Was there a schema migration or operator-run backfill?
lia: Nothing manual from Data infra. My hunch: the new dedupe flag + decreased replay backoff caused retries to enqueue many rehydrations.
anya: Cost alert also fired. We should cap new rehydrates at ingress while we triage — don't want to starve dedicated pools.
devon: Proposal: add a low-priority lane (background) for user-initiated reprocess jobs and enforce a per-tenant token bucket so one tenant can't take the whole cluster.
matt: Agreed. Also add a small API extension: accept X-Reprocess-Priority header and an X-Dry-Run to get a cost/time estimate before submitting.
lia: Console uses the current API; adding params needs console + api-lib coordination. Could we default to existing behavior to preserve compatibility?
anya: Yes — default should remain interactive. New header X-Reprocess-Priority=background will opt-in; console sends it once behind a feature flag.
devon: Dashboard impact: the aggregates page shows a single "queued" number. If we split lanes the UI will need to show lane counts, else users will be confused when total appears reduced.
matt: UI suggestion: show two tiles: Queued (interactive) and Queued (background) with SLA hints in tooltip.
lia: Ops-bot: "replayer: 03:10 spike - 4 worker OOMs, autoscale triggered"
ops-bot: replayer: 03:10 spike - 4 worker OOMs, autoscale triggered :warning:
anya: Safety plan: implement token bucket at API ingress for background lane + a global refill rate per cluster and daily tenant caps. Exceeding tokens returns 429 with clear guidance.
devon: Implementation notes: key = tenant:{id}:rehydration:tokens. Use Redis leaky-bucket. Configurable refill_rate and burst_size. Emit metrics tokens_granted, tokens_denied, tokens_consumed.
matt: Console flow: when user opens rehydrate modal call POST /v1/reprocess?dry_run=true returning {tokens_needed: N, cost_usd: "$X", est_minutes: Y, confidence: 0.6}. Show that in modal and allow priority selector.
lia: API sketch: ```
POST /v1/reprocess
Headers: X-Tenant, X-Dry-Run: true|false, X-Reprocess-Priority: interactive|background
Body: { "time_range": "2026-02-10T00:00Z/2026-02-10T03:00Z", "aggregate": "hourly" }
```
devon: Dry-run should sample shard sizes, current KV-cache hit rate, and recent enqueue rates to estimate tokens and duration. Return confidence based on sample variance.
anya: Rollout plan: behind backend + console feature flags. Start routing 5% of background lane traffic to the low-priority queue for 24h and monitor queued counts, token denies, and cost.
matt: Fallback behavior: if background lane saturates we should reject (429) rather than silently fall back to interactive and surprise customers. Ops can move jobs manually if needed.
devon: Add an operator endpoint to reclassify queued jobs between lanes for emergency rescue/drain: POST /internal/admin/move-jobs {from, to, filter}.
lia: Telemetry updates: the recompute dashboard assumes a single queue. Add panels: lane_breakdown, per_tenant_token_usage, dry_run_accuracy_over_time, and sample-only-run-rate.
anya: Also add a sample-only checkbox in the modal that creates sample tasks for ~10% of keys so users can verify outputs before a full run.
matt: Good idea. Show the dry_run confidence and link to the sample set used. Users want transparency on the estimate.
devon: We'll also emit an audit event for any reprocess created: tenant, time_range, priority, sample=true/false, tokens_consumed.
anya: Owners? I'll take the token bucket + metrics + redis config.
matt: I'll implement the console modal + dry_run UI and sample-only toggle.
devon: I'll own server API changes and routing rules + operator endpoint. Lia will update dashboards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary job replayer-v2-fix in cluster eu-1 for autoscale/oom mitigations.
anya: Timeline: implement token bucket + dry_run API by EOD Wednesday, console hookup Thursday, canary 5% Friday.
matt: One more UX ask: show estimated confidence as a small progress bar and a link "How we estimate" that shows sampling logic.
lia: Agree. Also add a small note about cost and a link to the per-tenant daily quota page.
devon: I'll add metrics for token refill_rate, deny_rate, and lane_queue_depth. We'll alert if deny_rate spikes or lane_queue_depth exceeds threshold.
anya: Ok I'll triage current queue: running a query to list top 10 tenants by queued rehydrates and will DM tenant owners.
matt: Thanks. Post results here when you have them. :thumbsup:
